annotation.title_en: Artificial intelligence in the military domain
annotation.authors_or_issuer: United Nations Office for Disarmament Affairs
annotation.venue: UN Office for Disarmament Affairs website
annotation.summary_en: UNODA web page describing UN work on AI in the military domain, including General Assembly resolution 79/239 (December 2024), the first on the topic, and the Secretary-General's report A/80/78 on opportunities and challenges for international peace and security, excluding lethal autonomous weapons.
key_provisions_or_claims: GA resolution 79/239 adopted 24 December 2024 is the first on AI in the military domain
Resolution affirms international law applies throughout the AI lifecycle
Resolution seeks to bridge divides on responsible military AI
Secretary-General report A/80/78 gathers views of states, organisations, civil society and industry
Report focuses on areas other than lethal autonomous weapons systems
